description: This Kotlin source file defines a singleton object 'MockData' containing sample recipe data for a recipe application. It includes predefined recipes with details like ingredients, steps, images, and several utility functions to search and filter recipes.

classes.name: Recipe
classes.description: Data class representing a recipe with details such as id, title, image, category, ingredients, steps, and other metadata.

classes.name: Ingredient
classes.description: Data class representing an ingredient used in recipes, with name and quantity.

classes.name: Step
classes.description: Data class representing a cooking step with step number and instruction.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches the recipes list for recipes matching the query in title, category, or ingredients.

methods.name: byCategory
methods.description: Filters recipes based on the provided category.

methods.name: byId
methods.description: Finds a recipe by its unique ID.
